item.title: Detecting Vulnerable nginx Servers with ZAP
item.description: NGINX2Root is a set of five nginx vulnerabilities which can take an attacker from a visitor to root on the server host. ZAP’s passive scanning can now flag nginx versions affected by them, and Apache HTTP Server gets the same treatment.

item.title: Detecting PHP2Shell and Other PHP Vulnerabilities with ZAP
item.description: PHP2Shell is the latest big “named” vulnerability. ZAP can now tell you if a site is running a vulnerable version of PHP, and it does so without sending a single extra request.
